hypothesis: In a tokenless evidence-based four-action toy causal environment, a learner that retains older confirmed residual signatures while allocating genuinely novel signatures from physically observed contradictory updates will choose three discriminating physical interventions and correctly predict one still-unqueried outcome for both changed and returned familiar relationship families. Frozen-old and recent-only controls will each fail on one family. Independent exact Bayesian all-history entropy control will tie, so no unique native scientific superiority is expected.

source.kind: original independently implemented but inspectable synthetic TRAIN source, not blind scientific first-use
source.public_protocol: context binary; three physically chosen earlier actions; fourth distractor action needed for terminal +/-1; no early reward, private source rule or alternative outcome
source.monomials: constant + 4 unary + 6 pairwise Boolean monomials over 4 public bits; 12 training patterns rank11
source.signature_selection: each cohort index %4, within support 4 examples per signature, update 2 each, eval 4 each
source.note: source per-world family and coefficient mask never passed to model, but source code inspectable; shifted outcomes all physical chosen consequences

primary_design.support_stage: 16 physical SUPPORT worlds each with 12 base public action episodes then all 4 residual intervention episodes; freeze after evidence captured
primary_design.adaptation_stage: 8 fresh shifted-family worlds, same physical 12+4 episodes each, ordered after prior; only true actually witnessed contradictory signatures may expand sparse relation memory
primary_design.candidate: keep all 16 past support world residual observations, allocate novel constraint-signature 5/10 after actually observed mismatch, retain all original K signatures, use balanced partition of ALL source-public evidence for each of 3 online queries
primary_design.exact_bayes: independent exact all-history Shannon-entropy information-gain over all 24 witnessed signatures, no private cohort indicator, no source query, no hidden class
primary_design.frozen_old: model receives and validates same 24 physical observations but purposely ignores last 8; uses first 16 prior for active three-probe policy
primary_design.recent_only: model receives and validates all 24 physical observations but purposely uses only last 8; tests interference/forgetting of old relationships
primary_design.no_memory: model receives same 24 physical observations but discards relational evidence and chooses fixed public positions [0,1,2], predicts unqueried residual zero
primary_design.future_shift_eval: 16 different base-rule worlds with shifted signature family, each method fits same 12 new physical base actions, executes exactly three selected physical residual probes, then predicts and physically applies one still-unqueried residual action
primary_design.future_return_eval: 16 distinct base-rule worlds returning to original K signature family; same three query+one score budgets without model regime labels; no explicit family flag
metrics: earned first unqueried predictions per 16 worlds, two disjoint cohorts
novel signature allocation count from observed source evidence
old+new learned relation preserved in cold checkpoint
posterior distinct law count and support examples after three physical probes
baseline failures from missing old/new relation evidence
per-world exact public action/outcome receipts and time/CPU costs
bootstrap difference over strongest fully fitted independent exact Bayesian

bootstrap.unit: paired source world cluster separately by cohort

primary_design.postresult: No revision of source seeds, metrics, masks, scores, or model after original full evaluation; report mismatches as negatives, preserve failures

engineering.focused_source_safe_unit_tests: support/update only; never eval shift/return first-use in focused tests
engineering.proof_archive: upload full per-world physical source receipt artifact even if downstream independent scoring audit fails, verify artifact exists before audit

science.qualification_limit: finite prechosen residual patterns and base GF2 basis, known family variants; independent Bayesian tie expected
science.negative_to_preserve: shift-only or old-only policies fail return/shift respectively; if no improvement, report NO-GO, no post-result tuning
